items.html:
Part of the St Georges team who won their second consecutive Cup in August 2006, Delyone is an improving offspinner who has also opened the batting for Bermuda. Although he is still learning his trade he performed encouragingly in the 2005 ICC Trophy picking up 7 wickets at an average of 24.71, which was just as well after struggling to score just 68 runs innings. He was the leading wicket-taker for Bermuda in the recent World Cricket League in Kenya and is an excellent fielder.
Alan Curr February 2007
